name: (New game: Gibby!) Time For Delivery!
summary:
[ (This game is discontinued! :) ]
Time For Delivery is a game where you go gamemode to gamemode having fun, dressing up, roleplaying, and socializing! (of course if you CHOOSE to do those things.)

Several game modes to play, a LOT of cosmetics you could put on, along with faces, and a cool lobby map!

Will you stay away from Boxazon Fufilment Center, or will you ROCK the Fufilment Center?
